title: discovery.py: Unconditional cache.add may install stale routes
description: Lines 196-205: gradient.update is conditional on _is_seq_fresher check, but cache.add runs unconditionally. When a stale RREP arrives (older seq_num from retransmission/delay), the gradient preserves the fresher entry but cache is overwritten with stale data. This creates gradient/cache inconsistency and could cause routing to use outdated next_hop information.
